title: Fix and harden computeInvoiceTotal
prompt:
The function `computeInvoiceTotal` in `src/invoice.js` is wrong and under-specified. Make it conform to this specification:

- `lines` is an array of `{ unitPriceCents, quantity }`. `subtotalCents` is the sum of `unitPriceCents * quantity`. An empty array gives all zeros.
- `options` is optional. `discountPct` and `taxPct` both default to 0.
- `discountCents` is `discountPct` percent of the subtotal, rounded half up to the nearest cent.
- Tax is applied AFTER the discount: `taxCents` is `taxPct` percent of `(subtotalCents - discountCents)`, rounded half up to the nearest cent.
- `totalCents = subtotalCents - discountCents + taxCents`.
- Throw `RangeError` if `discountPct` is outside 0..100 or `taxPct` is negative.
- Throw `TypeError` if any line has a `unitPriceCents` or `quantity` that is not a non-negative integer.
- Return `{ subtotalCents, discountCents, taxCents, totalCents }`.

Only modify `src/invoice.js`. Do not modify, add or delete tests or any other file. You can run the existing tests with `npm test`.
